title: Python for Machine Learning
overview: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to Machine Learning (ML) using Python, covering data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and deployment. Participants will gain hands-on experience with key ML libraries like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, and Pandas, enabling them to build and deploy machine learning models efficiently.
audience: Aspiring Machine Learning Engineers & Data Scientists
Software Developers looking to integrate ML into applications
Business Analysts & Data Professionals interested in predictive analytics
methodology: Hands-on Labs – Practical coding exercises and real-world ML projects
Live Demonstrations – Step-by-step walkthroughs of ML model building
Case Studies & Best Practices – Industry use cases for ML
Collaborative Learning – Group projects and peer discussions
Capstone Project – Developing an end-to-end ML solution
competencies: Neural Networks & Deep Learning with TensorFlow/Keras
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Apply Python for Machine Learning tasks
Prepare and preprocess datasets for ML modeling
Train and evaluate ML models using Scikit-learn
Optimize models using feature selection and hyperparameter tuning
Implement Neural Networks and Deep Learning models
Deploy ML models into production environments

outline.title: Module 1: Introduction to Machine Learning with Python

items.text: Python’s Role in ML – Why Python?
Setting Up the ML Development Environment (Jupyter, VS Code, Anaconda)
Introduction to Key Libraries (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras)
Data Cleaning: Handling Missing Values, Outliers, and Duplicates
Feature Engineering: Encoding Categorical Variables, Scaling, and Normalization

outline.title: Module 3: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) & Data Visualization

items.text: Evaluating Model Performance (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, AUC-ROC)
Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for Dimensionality Reduction

outline.title: Module 6: Neural Networks & Deep Learning (Intro to TensorFlow/Keras)

items.text: Basics of Neural Networks & Deep Learning
Implementing a Simple Neural Network with TensorFlow/Keras
Introduction to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) & Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs)
Using Docker & Kubernetes for ML Model Deployment
Introduction to ML Model Monitoring & A/B Testing
